sources.name: Kode dan data wilayah administrasi Kemendagri 2025
sources.snapshot: Kepmendagri 300.2.2-2138/2025 dated 2025-04-25, as amended by Kepmendagri 300.2.2-2430/2025 dated 2025-06-23

license_review.basis: Public legal documents distributed by JDIH/BPK; no license over a separately extracted database is assumed.
license_review.attribution: Kementerian Dalam Negeri Republik Indonesia, decision number and access date

pii_review.finding: The annex contains administrative units and aggregate geography/population fields, not person-level address records.
pii_review.controls: Extract only region code, region name, hierarchy level, and parent relationship. Drop population and unrelated columns.

transformation_plan: Retain immutable downloaded files and acquisition manifest outside Git.
Parse the base annex into the canonical region hierarchy.
Apply the amendment before publishing a reference snapshot.
Retain source_id and artifact SHA-256 in every derived manifest.
limitations: This source is an administrative hierarchy, not a postal-code authority.
The PDF layout requires extraction validation and spot checks against the rendered document.
Internal use is approved; redistribution of an extracted database needs a separate legal decision.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap Indonesia extract via Geofabrik
sources.publisher: OpenStreetMap contributors; extract produced by Geofabrik GmbH

license_review.basis: OpenStreetMap data is licensed under ODbL 1.0.
license_review.attribution: Copyright OpenStreetMap contributors; link to https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright and identify ODbL

pii_review.finding: The public Geofabrik extract removes contributor user names, user IDs, and changeset IDs. OSM objects can still contain free-text tags.
pii_review.controls: Do not ingest history extracts. Allowlist only road, place, address, postal-code, and selected landmark tags; reject contact/name/free-text tags not needed by the task.

transformation_plan: Verify the upstream MD5 and record an additional SHA-256 in the acquisition manifest.
Clip records to Indonesia because the extract also includes East Timor.
Allowlist required tags and remove contributor metadata and unrelated free text.
Carry source_id, OSM object identifiers, snapshot date, and ODbL attribution into derived manifests.
limitations: Community coverage and tag consistency vary by region.
OSM is corroborating evidence, not an authority for administrative or postal correctness.
Derived databases distributed outside the team remain subject to ODbL obligations.

sources.name: ALAMATIN synthetic NER review examples v1
sources.snapshot: NER schema 1.0.0 fixture at repository commit f045d2d

license_review.basis: Contributor-authored synthetic examples tracked in this repository.

pii_review.finding: Examples are synthetic and include no customer records, real recipients, phone numbers, or contact identifiers.
pii_review.controls: Keep the benchmark synthetic and run the repository secret/PII review before adding examples.

transformation_plan: Validate schema_version, label order, unique IDs, and BIO transitions.
Use only as a deterministic smoke benchmark until a separately governed evaluation dataset is frozen.
Carry source_id into the future dataset manifest.
limitations: Twenty curated examples are insufficient for model selection or performance claims.
Synthetic examples do not measure real marketplace address distribution or error prevalence.
This source must never be mixed into the sealed real test.

sources.name: Kode Pos Desa/Kelurahan di Indonesia
sources.publisher: Dinas Komunikasi dan Informatika Provinsi Jawa Barat via Open Data Jabar

license_review.basis: Open Data Jabar terms allow personal non-commercial use; broader commercial reuse was not granted in the reviewed terms.
license_review.attribution: Open Data Jabar and Dinas Perpustakaan dan Kearsipan Daerah Provinsi Jawa Barat, dataset ID and snapshot

pii_review.finding: The documented fields contain administrative units and postal codes, not people or household-level addresses.
pii_review.controls: Allowlist only hierarchy codes/names, postal code, and year; do not join to customer records in the build stage.

transformation_plan: Keep only Jawa Barat rows and the documented hierarchy/postal-code fields.
Use Kemendagri province/district/village codes and derive the city parent from the Kemendagri district prefix; retain differing BPS names as aliases.
Record every name, parent-code, and postal-code disagreement in the exception report.
Record source_id, source snapshot, and raw artifact SHA-256 on every canonical row.
limitations: The published endpoint returned a Cloudflare HTTP 403 challenge on 2026-08-11; no bypass was attempted.
The snapshot is a compiled dataset and must be cross-checked against Kemendagri, BPS SIG, and selected manual Pos Indonesia observations.
Use is limited to internal non-commercial work unless broader permission is recorded.

documented_exceptions.scope: Redistribution, in the public ALAMATIN repository, of the derived Jawa Barat postal reference output only: data/processed/jabar-reference-v1-verified.json, data/final/jabar-postal-app-lookup.csv, and their jabar-reference-v1-exceptions.csv/jabar-reference-v1-summary.json manifests. Not the raw Open Data Jabar extract or its per-source value column.
documented_exceptions.basis: The published rows are a new, human-adjudicated work product: every value passed corroboration against Diskominfo, Kodepos.dev, and, for previously unresolved rows, a Pos Indonesia spot-check, with evidence and reviewer decisions recorded privately in data/interim/postal-review/. The raw extract, per-source columns, and reviewer worksheets are not redistributed -- only the single adjudicated postal_code per village_code.
documented_exceptions.policy_effect: Applies only to the specific derived files listed above. Does not change the standing internal_noncommercial_only decision or metadata_and_synthetic_fixtures_only redistribution limit for the raw Open Data Jabar extract itself; any other redistribution needs its own dated review.

sources.name: Data Master Kode Desa/Kelurahan
sources.publisher: Kementerian Dalam Negeri Republik Indonesia via Satu Data Indonesia

license_review.basis: Public government dataset metadata and API were recorded; the portal notes that SDI principle fulfillment remains in progress.
license_review.attribution: Kementerian Dalam Negeri Republik Indonesia and Satu Data Indonesia, dataset ID and snapshot

pii_review.finding: The dataset describes administrative village/kelurahan master codes and names, not person-level data.
pii_review.controls: Retain only administrative code, name, level, and parent relationship.

transformation_plan: Normalize the response into the cross-check CSV contract documented for the hierarchy builder.
Filter to Jawa Barat and compare by normalized ten-digit village code.
Record differences as exceptions; never overwrite primary values silently.
limitations: The resource host did not resolve from the build environment on 2026-08-11.
The portal states that fulfillment of Satu Data Indonesia principles is still in progress.
This source does not establish a postal code.

sources.name: Relationship Table BPS Wilkerstat, Kemendagri, and postal codes
sources.snapshot: SIG relationship-table page observed 2026-08-11; options include 2020 semester 2 administrative relationships and 2017 semester 2 postal-code relationships

license_review.basis: The relationship tables and an interactive download control were identified, but no stable direct artifact URL and reuse terms were recorded.
license_review.attribution: Badan Pusat Statistik, table edition and access date

pii_review.finding: The described relationship tables contain geographic codes and names, not person-level records.
pii_review.controls: Do not acquire until a stable artifact and terms are recorded; after approval retain only hierarchy and postal relationship fields.

acquisition.reason: Stable direct download URL, immutable artifact version, and reuse terms require confirmation.

transformation_plan: After approval, normalize the selected relationship table into the documented cross-check CSV contract.
Compare codes and names to canonical rows and emit exceptions for every difference.
limitations: The postal relationship option is based on 2015 postal codes and may be stale.
The source remains on hold and may only be represented by synthetic test fixtures.

sources.name: Kodepos.dev REST API
sources.snapshot: Live credentialed REST API; every observation records its explicit access date

license_review.basis: The service terms permit API access but prohibit resale or redistribution of its data without written permission. ALAMATIN uses responses only as ignored local validation evidence.
license_review.attribution: Kodepos.dev REST API, endpoint and access date

pii_review.finding: The documented response contains public administrative codes/names and postal codes, not people or household addresses.
pii_review.controls: Allowlist only hierarchy code/name and postalCode. Never send customer addresses, names, phone numbers, or other free text. Keep response artifacts in ignored data/interim paths.

acquisition.reason: Use a dedicated explicit REST validation script; generic catalog acquisition and redistribution remain disabled.

transformation_plan: For targeted checks, select only village codes from already documented conflicts or coverage gaps.
For an explicitly confirmed province audit, use documented search pagination with scripts/audit_kodepos_jabar.py and checkpoint every page.
Use an environment-only API key for every request.
Normalize allowlisted fields into the cross-check CSV contract and retain endpoint plus access-date provenance.
Treat differences as exceptions; never silently overwrite the canonical government-source value.
limitations: This is a live third-party service rather than an immutable government snapshot.
Each request consumes service credits and is subject to rate limits and account terms.
Generated observations are internal validation evidence and must not be committed or redistributed.
The targeted client caps each invocation at 100 selected village codes and defaults to 25; the province audit requires an explicit confirmation flag and consumes additional credits.

documented_exceptions.scope: Redistribution, in the public ALAMATIN repository, of the derived Jawa Barat postal reference output only: data/processed/jabar-reference-v1-verified.json, data/final/jabar-postal-app-lookup.csv, and their jabar-reference-v1-exceptions.csv/jabar-reference-v1-summary.json manifests. Not Kodepos.dev API responses, its per-source value column, or raw cross-check observations.
documented_exceptions.basis: Same as the open_data_jabar_postal_2023 exception recorded on this date: the published table is a new, human-adjudicated work product (a single postal_code per village_code, with evidence and reviewer decisions recorded privately), not a redistribution of Kodepos.dev's raw responses or a bulk repository dataset built from them.
documented_exceptions.policy_effect: Applies only to the specific derived files listed above. Does not change the standing internal_validation_only decision or the prohibited redistribution status for raw Kodepos.dev API responses/observations; any other redistribution needs its own dated review.

sources.name: Pos Indonesia postal-code search
sources.snapshot: Live search service; no immutable bulk snapshot identified

license_review.basis: The official search service was identified, but bulk-access and reuse terms were not found.

pii_review.controls: Do not scrape or query in bulk while the source remains on hold.

acquisition.reason: Requires written terms/API confirmation and a reproducible snapshot mechanism.

limitations: Interactive lookup is not a reproducible bulk dataset.
No reuse or redistribution permission has been recorded.

documented_exceptions.scope: Two bounded, dated internal review passes to corroborate already-open Jawa Barat postal-review rows: two-source candidate corroboration ("Section 2") and remaining unresolved rows ("Section 3"). Not a general bulk-acquisition approval.
documented_exceptions.method: Dedicated script scripts/fetch_pos_indonesia_candidates.py, not the generic scripts/acquire_sources.py path, which still refuses this source_id per its hold decision. Rate-limited: 2-second delay between requests, 100-query batches, batch pauses, response cache to avoid repeat queries.
documented_exceptions.volume: 917 unique village-name queries across both passes
documented_exceptions.output_handling: Search-result observations only (queried name, returned candidates, exact/no-match/multiple-match status). Never redistributed; kept in data/interim/postal-review/, which stays out of the public repository. Only the reviewer-adjudicated postal_code value, not the raw search response, is promoted into governed reference output after human review and evidence recording.
documented_exceptions.policy_effect: Applies only to the rows in scope for this exception. Does not change the standing hold decision for this source_id; any further or different bulk use requires a new, separately dated and scoped exception record here.
